info.name: Pokédle
info.description: Pokédle is a free daily Pokémon Wordle: guess the mystery Pokémon in 8 tries from clues about generation, type, height, weight, color and evolution stage.
info.intro: Pokédle is our Pokémon Wordle: one mystery Pokémon, eight guesses, and a new Pokémon every day.
info.step1: Type the name of a Pokémon and submit it as your guess.
info.step2: Each guess shows how it compares with the mystery Pokémon: generation, type, height, weight, color and evolution stage.
info.step3: Use the clues to narrow it down and find the answer within 8 tries.
info.step4: Come back tomorrow for a new Pokémon, or challenge a friend or a stranger to a live duel.
info.faqGuessesQ: How many guesses do I get?
info.faqGuessesA: You have 8 tries to find the mystery Pokémon.
info.faqCluesQ: What clues does each guess show?
info.faqCluesA: Generation, type, height, weight, color and evolution stage, compared with the mystery Pokémon.
